proofOfFundsRequirement: Full 1-year estimated tuition + living costs on I-20 form (approx. $30,000 - $65,000 in liquid bank funds).
workPermissions: Up to 20 hours/week on-campus during academic terms; 40 hours during breaks. Off-campus allowed via CPT/OPT.
postStudyWorkVisa: OPT (12 months) + STEM OPT Extension (24 months total 36 months).
keyRequirements: Form I-20 issued by SEVP-certified institution
Paid SEVIS I-901 fee receipt
DS-160 Online Nonimmigrant Visa Application
Valid passport (at least 6 months beyond intended stay)
Financial proof (bank statements, affidavit of support, scholarship letters)
In-person interview at US Embassy/Consulate
tips: Book embassy appointment immediately upon receiving your I-20. Be prepared to prove non-immigrant intent during the F-1 interview.

proofOfFundsRequirement: Course fees for year 1 + £1,334/month (London) or £1,023/month (outside London) for 9 months. Held in account for 28 consecutive days.
workPermissions: Up to 20 hours/week during term-time for degree-level courses; full-time during holidays.
postStudyWorkVisa: Graduate Route Visa (2 years for Bachelor's/Master's, 3 years for PhD).
keyRequirements: Confirmation of Acceptance for Studies (CAS) from licensed sponsor
Valid passport and TB test results (if required)
28-day bank statement meeting maintenance funds requirement
ATAS certificate (for applicable STEM research courses)
English proficiency proof (IELTS UKVI or university assessment)
tips: Ensure bank statements strictly meet the 28-day rule ending within 31 days before application date.

proofOfFundsRequirement: $20,635 CAD living allowance + year 1 tuition fee (Updated 2024 requirement). Guaranteed Investment Certificate (GIC) recommended.
workPermissions: Up to 20 hours/week off-campus during terms; full-time during scheduled breaks.
postStudyWorkVisa: Post-Graduation Work Permit (PGWP) up to 3 years depending on program length.
keyRequirements: Letter of Acceptance (LOA) from a Designated Learning Institution (DLI)
Provincial Attestation Letter (PAL) if applicable
Proof of funds ($20,635 CAD + tuition)
Clean criminal record / Police certificate
Medical examination report
Statement of Purpose (SOP / Letter of Explanation)
tips: Apply through Student Direct Stream (SDS) if eligible in your country for accelerated 20-day processing with a $10,000 CAD GIC.

proofOfFundsRequirement: Sperrkonto (Blocked Account) with €11,208 per year (€934/month) or official Declaration of Commitment (Verpflichtungserklärung).
workPermissions: 140 full days or 280 half days per calendar year. Academic student assistant (HiWi) work has no limit.
keyRequirements: Unconditional University Admission Letter (Zulassungsbescheid)
Proof of Blocked Account (€11,208) via Expatrio, Fintiba, or Coracle
German statutory or private health insurance confirmation
Recognized secondary school certificate / APS Certificate (for China, India, Vietnam)
Motivation Letter and CV in German/English
tips: Open your Blocked Account (Sperrkonto) early as funds transfer can take a week.

feeFormatted: $710 AUD Visa Fee + OSHC Health Cover
proofOfFundsRequirement: $24,505 AUD living expenses + 1 year tuition + travel fare.
workPermissions: Up to 48 hours per fortnight during study terms; unlimited during scheduled breaks.
postStudyWorkVisa: Temporary Graduate Visa (Subclass 485) for 2 to 4 years.
keyRequirements: Electronic Confirmation of Enrolment (eCoE) from Australian CRICOS provider
Genuine Student (GS) criteria assessment
Overseas Student Health Cover (OSHC) for entire study duration
Proof of funds ($24,505 AUD + tuition)
English language proficiency test (IELTS 6.0+ or PTE/TOEFL)
tips: Ensure your Genuine Student (GS) statement focuses on your academic intent and economic benefits of returning home.

proofOfFundsRequirement: Proof of sufficient funds for tuition and living costs (~$15,000 SGD).
workPermissions: Up to 16 hours/week during term-time at approved institutions; full-time during vacations.
postStudyWorkVisa: 1-Year Long Term Visit Pass (LTVP) for job search post-graduation.
keyRequirements: In-Principle Approval (IPA) letter from ICA
SOLAR application registration by local institution
Valid passport and passport photos
Medical checkup (including HIV test and chest X-ray upon arrival)
E-Form 16 submitted through ICA SOLAR system
tips: Complete your SOLAR registration promptly after your university issues your approval code.

proofOfFundsRequirement: Approx. ¥2,000,000 JPY (~$14,000 USD) in sponsor bank account.
workPermissions: Up to 28 hours/week with 'Permission to Engage in Activity Other Than That Permitted' permit.
postStudyWorkVisa: Designated Activities Visa for job-hunting (up to 1 year, extendable to 2 years).
keyRequirements: Certificate of Eligibility (COE) issued by Japanese Immigration Bureau
Official Letter of Admission from Japanese University
Valid passport and visa application form
Sponsor financial verification / Bank balance certificate
Academic transcripts and graduation diplomas
tips: Apply for work permit at immigration control upon initial entry at Tokyo Narita/Haneda or Kansai Airport.

proofOfFundsRequirement: Minimum €615/month for the duration of the academic year (€7,380 per year).
workPermissions: Up to 964 hours per year (60% of standard annual work limit).
postStudyWorkVisa: APS (Autorisation Provisoire de Séjour) for 1 year post-Master's.
keyRequirements: EEF (Études en France) account confirmation via Campus France
Official Acceptance Letter from French Higher Education Institution
Proof of minimum €615/month income / scholarship award
Proof of accommodation for first 3 months
Valid passport and France-Visas receipt
tips: You must complete the Campus France procedure before booking your visa appointment.

proofOfFundsRequirement: Minimum €1,000/month living allowance + tuition fee deposited to university account.
workPermissions: Up to 16 hours/week OR full-time during June, July, and August (requires TWV work permit).
postStudyWorkVisa: Orientation Year Visa (Zoekjaar) for 1 year post-graduation.
keyRequirements: University submits IND visa application on your behalf
Proof of sufficient financial means (€12,000/year living costs)
Tuberculosis test (if applicable upon arrival)
Antecedents certificate (clean criminal record declaration)
Valid passport
tips: Your university handles the IND permit application directly after you pay the deposit.

proofOfFundsRequirement: $20,000 USD (Seoul area) or $18,000 USD (outside Seoul) in bank account.
workPermissions: Up to 20 hours/week during semesters (TOPIK Level 3+ required); unlimited during vacations.
postStudyWorkVisa: D-10 Job Seeking Visa (up to 2 years).
keyRequirements: Standard Admission Letter issued by Korean University
Business Registration Certificate of the university
Proof of funds ($20,000 USD bank statement held for 30+ days)
Family relationship proof (if using parents' bank statement)
High school diploma or Bachelor's degree verified via Apostille/Consular confirmation
tips: Obtain TOPIK Level 3 early to unlock maximum part-time work privileges.
